user_scenario: You are Daniel Pettigrew, 43, a ferry dispatcher in Providence, Rhode Island, and a Larkspur Premier member. Larkspur Pharmacy mails you teriflunomide every month. You are friendly but brisk, a bit annoyed, and you talk in short sentences. You open by saying that the October refill of your teriflunomide, the one that came overnight, was charged noticeably more than your earlier monthly refills even though you are a Premier member, and that you want whatever you were overcharged on that October order refunded. You never name an amount you think is right. Give identifying details only when asked: your Larkspur patient number is LH-8330862 and your date of birth is February 8, 1983 (1983-02-08); if more is needed, your mobile is 6175550151 and your ZIP code is 02906. If asked which order, it is the October 9th shipment. If the agent tells you something on that order has to be paid before the refund can be worked out, you grumble briefly but agree, and you explain that the card Larkspur has on file was cancelled last week after a fraud alert, so you will pay it yourself with your new card. When the agent quotes the amount and hands the payment step over to you, you make that payment yourself for exactly the quoted amount on the October order. When the agent confirms the refund has been issued, you say thanks and end the call.

design_rationale:
WHY A GOOD TEST: Daniel Pettigrew (Premier Annual, active) wants the overcharge on his October 9 teriflunomide shipment refunded. The cash shipment refund nets the whole shipment against everything collected, and its prerequisite sentence ('The cash shipment refund is worked out only after the shipment's records carry a shipping line for the dispensed fill whenever the shipping fee the cash shipment refund allows is above zero.') is unmet: the overnight shipment went out with no shipping line. The agent must price the owed shipping (28.45: Premier overnight 15.00 + peak 3.50 + Friday weekend transit 8.00 + protection 1.95), hand it to the patient as his own payment (card on file cancelled), then price the shipment (75.65 drug at the Premier 15 percent + 28.45 shipping) against 117.45 collected: refund 13.35. Refunding the 13.35 drug difference alone without the owed shipping, or netting the unpaid fee, are the tempting wrong paths.
SCOPE: task 1 claims rx_ext_owed_shipping_payment (user) and rx_ext_cash_shipment_refund (agent) and their tools (cash-price-basis shipments); task 0 holds the cash-member-price and benefit-basis policies. Disjoint; together all five policies are covered.
DRAW: prerequisite_problems=1, factor_counts=[4,5] -> owed shipping 4, cash shipment refund 5.
TREE: root rx_ext_cash_shipment_refund <- rx_ext_owed_shipping_payment, value_input, state form, gate `collected`; false at opening (no shipping line on 86b786ea-ac45-4839-bf4f-02a57c07f68a); exactly one write in the difficulty posts shipping charge lines (the owed shipping payment). Skipping it gives refund 0.00 (89.00 collected < 104.10 allowed).
FACTOR CARD: owed shipping 28.45 (premier 38.40, peak 24.95, weekend 20.45, protection 26.50; all-baseline 24.95); refund 13.35 (member 0.00, premier 3.40, peak 16.85, weekend 21.35, protection 15.30; all-baseline 3.50). Cross-difficulty: membership_holdings Premier Annual active (member_percent multi-source tier AND status). Near-misses: earlier monthly fills priced 75.65 and shipped standard (no surcharges, no line); the 90-day parcel clause does not apply to a 30-day fill.
BASE INVARIANTS: owed shipping line inherits rx_evt_shipping.free_expedited_state (membership active); refund inherits rx_returns_and_reships.one_refund_per_line (no refund on the October line). Overwrites: shipping schedule sentence; correction clause (whole-shipment refund on cash-price-basis shipments, sibling case of pbm-basis lines named in the same sentence).
SEED: Premier Annual since 2024-11-04 (99.00 fee, 899.00 dues 2024 and 2025); June 10 completed Primary Care Follow-Up (membership_included, nothing charged); four correct monthly fills; no coverage held (cash).
PERSONA: brisk dispatcher; volunteers the October overcharge only; identity when asked; agrees to pay what is owed only after the agent says so, explaining the cancelled card; pays exactly the quoted amount.
SOLUTION: find_customers -> verify -> prescriptions, fills, charges, membership, membership charges, visit -> hand over owed shipping 28.45 -> refund 13.35 on the October fill charge line.
